# Pull Request Template

## Summary

Briefly describe what this PR changes and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] `pnpm run build:registry` passes (if registry items changed)
- [ ] A changeset was added with `pnpm changeset` (if a release is intended)
- [ ] Prettier formatting applied (`pnpm exec prettier --write`)
